script.speaker: Blooper voice
script.prompt:
Russian dubbing for a classic cartoon game. Low gruff raspy male cartoon voice, slightly confused broken fragments from a studio blooper. Clear Russian fragments, no invented words, no named actor imitation. Use the SAME character voice throughout. Speak every Russian sentence exactly and completely, no missing words. Brisk clear conversational rhythm, around 3 Russian words per second. No music, no sound effects, no introduction or conclusion. Read ONLY the Russian text of each entry below. Do not say entry numbers or labels. Leave TWO SECONDS of SILENCE between entries so the editor can split recordings. Do not say any separator words. Begin and end with a short silence.

1. Из всех этих…

2. овец…

3. овчарок…
